balls.text: four more, and 23 off the over!! It's another one of those totals close to 250! PBKS bash 243 off 20 overs, and Shashank ends the innings by ramping this over short third. Another short ball from Siraj, as this pitched outside off and shaped back in to finish over middle. Shashank waited, before flaying it away

another boundary! So Iyer will remain off strike for the last ball of the over too! Damn! Another inswinger from Siraj, and this one pitched on a length and just outside leg. Shashank clipped that aerially to deep-backward square leg, and beat the diving fielder to his right
wide ball! This swings in and pitches full and outside leg. He looked to whip but missed

swatted to deep cover point! Will Iyer get to his hundred?! Another short delivery from Siraj, who bowls this wide of off. With the fielder being on at deep-backward point, Shashank clubs it away for four

drilled wide of mid-off! Superb shot! He opens the face of the bat very slightly, and even as the ball is nearly a yorker around off, he's deep enough inside the crease to find the gap between mid-off and extra cover
two for Shashank, so Iyer remains off strike. Full and swinging in, as it arrives on middle and off, before Shashank whips it wide of deep midwicket
upper cut over short third! Siraj bowls short too, and around seventh stump. The ball shapes back in to finish on top of off, but Shashank gets on top of the bounce to send that away
another yorker from Rabada, as he floats it just outside off. Shashank goes deep in the crease, and clips off the inside half of the bat to deep square leg
short again, and around fifth stump. Pulled off the higher side of the bat towards deep-backward square leg
between short third and deep point! They were moving in each other's direction after Shashank went ramping at this short ball outside off, but seemed to be beaten by the extra bounce
nearly a wide yorker outside off. Shashank looked to whip off his bottom hand, but the ball ended up going on the bounce to Rabada

nicely bowled, and well played too! Rabada bowled an inswinging yorker which landed on off, as Iyer opened the face of the bat to guide it to short third, where Kishore tumbled to his right to keep it to one
another wide! Rabada now bowls short and even wider of off, nearly landing it outside the pitch on the off side. Iyer lets it go
wide ball! Rabada goes on a shortish length, but really wide of off. Left alone by Iyer

flicked to deep-backward square leg! Effortless from Iyer, who uses the pace on the ball to dispatch the ball. He uses his wrists to play at this aerially, as this fullish ball swings in nicely to arrive on his pads
flat, hard and six! Rashid bowls full and flatter, and a bit wide of off. But Shashank is ready and waiting, and crushes it back to just clear the boundary
very full on his pads, and whipped towards deep square leg for a hurried two
swatted wide of long-off! Another short delivery from Rashid, although he pitches this wide of off. The ball turns away further, and Shashank throws his bat at it to bag four more
short in length, and six! Shashank shifted his weight back, and pulled hard for six over midwicket
pushes a fullish ball outside off to cover
he looked to sweep but the ball dribbled off his pads behind square

more luck goes Iyer's way! He's nearly taken there! Tewatia, at long-on, took the catch while leaping, and almost seemed to have tickled the rope. The third umpire checks multiple replays from various angles, with Tewatia's right leg seemingly touching the rope. He's falling over to the other side of the boundary, and throws the ball back. The ball is popped back as Tewatia falls outside the boundary, with the third umpire still not convinced despite having looked at it around 19 times. Finally, after a few minutes of replays, it is not given as six. Iyer had slammed at another length ball down the ground this time, and only got two for his efforts
six more! Krishna is being toyed with! This is flung over wide long-off! A fullish ball around sixth stump from Krishna, and Iyer, despite hanging deep in the crease, belts it for another maximum

six! Just! Rabada touches the rope after taking the ball! Nearly a no-look six there, as he swivels to hook this short delivery rising sharply around off. In fact, he took his eyes off and went for the shot, with the ball flying off the top half of the bat

slapped over backward point! A one-bounce four, as Iyer plays at this late after spotting a good-length ball pretty wide of off. Deep third was also inside the circle, so there was nothing to worry about there
bam! Iyer hits back! On a good length, and around sixth stump, as Iyer shifts his weight back to swat-pull it wide of long-on for another six

pings Iyer just below his right shoulder! Iyer immediately clutches his ribcage, and there's a stoppage in play. Replays show he got a bottom edge there, as he looked to pull at a short delivery just outside off. The physio has a check, and we're ready again
low full toss, and angled into middle and leg. Clipped to short fine leg's left, with the fielder doing well to slide and stop it
Kishore appeals rather animatedly for lbw, but it is turned down. Shashank looked to lap sweep, but was hit on his pad, as the ball dribbled behind the wicket
shorter side of a length on off, and quicker too. The ball straightens after pitching, and is pushed towards deep midwicket
full and slow, and just outside off. Driven towards mid-off to get off the mark

reverse swept to short third! Stoinis' fun ends. Arshad signals that the light was in his eyes, but he still had only a simple catch to take. Kishore angled it in from around the wicket again, but seemed to have bowled slower than the previous ball. He went on the fuller side again, and once again, just about on off or thereabouts. Stoinis went reverse sweeping, but couldn't get it above the fielder
six down the ground! On a fullish length, and angling in as it pitches around off. Stoinis clears his front leg, and bashes it back
he has helped it along the way to clear fine leg! Picks length early, swivels back and comes through with the pull. Ball flew off the bat
whips this low full toss to deep midwicket
dug in short, Stoinis bails out of an upper cut in anticipation of a wide, not given. They've reviewed. Replays confirm this was way over his head, original decision reversed. Wide it is
into the blockhole, squeezed to deep midwicket
misses the flick as Siraj sprays this down leg
pulled again, one bounce to deep midwicket this time
flat hit for six! Picks the length early and plays a superb pull in front of square to clear deep midwicket.
length ball on middle, pushed to point, looks for a single but is sent back
man, oh, man! Sweeeeet. This is deposited deep into the stands at deep midwicket. And the key to execution was picking the length early. Got as close as he could to the pitch and waltzed it.

picks the wrong'un and slaps it over long-on to bring up a sensational half-century! Made room to go over cover but the moment he spotted the googly off the hand, he held his shape and hammered it down the ground.
paddled but doesn't get that off the sweet spot, lobs to backward square leg
taps it with soft hands to point for a quick single
beaten by sharp turn and bite off the pitch. Shreyas was squared up
square driven straight to point
driven straight to cover
reverse-swept over short third! Stoinis is able to execute what Maxwell couldn't off a very similar delivery. PBKS up and running again after the double-strike
punched back past the bowler
looked for a second as if he'd dragged this to wide long-on but has got enough power to clear the man there! Didn't get to the pitch but went through with the stroke. Pure muscle
cuts straight to point
what a way to break the shackles! A high-quality stroke as he steps out and moves leg side of the ball to loft inside-out to clear long-off. Clean hit
right behind the line in defence
whips it uppishly to deep square for a single
wrong'un on middle and leg, tucked past square leg
driven straight to cover, pressure building
tossed up on middle, defended back
shortish on middle, worked to wide long-on as they jog the single
lovely loop and guile, gets this to land on a length on middle and turn away gently, Stoinis gets forward and defends.
tossed up outside off, pushed to cover

and he's gone first ball! Attempts a reverse sweep and he misses it altogether as Sai Kishore has two in two. This one was bowled full and drifted in from wide of the crease, once Maxwell missed, he was a dead duck.

heaved towards deep midwicket, easy catch for Arshad. Didn't get to the pitch but went through with the shot. It didn't help that Azmat was trying to clear the longest boundary. He was looking to go straighter but ended up dragging it to the fielder.
slider from around the stumps, Azmat cuts straight to point
driven to sweeper cover with the spin
short again, and great bounce again! Krishna bowls this around sixth stump, and Omarzai looked to ramp but missed. Good use of the short ball and bouncer in this over from Krishna
another short delivery on a wide-ish line outside off, and Omarzai's beaten again. He looked to pull at it, but the ball went over his bat. Krishna continues to get some extra bounce here

lofted over mid-off! Krishna switches his length to a fullish one, and even as the ball swings in to pitch on the stumps, Omarzai is all ready to attack at that with a high left elbow and the full face of the bat
sharp short ball at 144kph! He banged it hard on the pitch, and just outside off, as Omarzai looked to hook, but the ball zoomed over his bat there
shorter side of a length, and slightly wide of off. He looks to pull without any foot movement, and is beaten
swatted wide of mid-off! A powerful thumping at a good-length ball arriving around fifth stump, as bisects the gap between extra cover and mid-off
very full and quick, and on middle. Iyer looks to whip, but gets a leading edge towards cover
fuller, and close to off. Driven to long-off
wow, more turn, and even low bounce! On a fullish length length around middle and off, and turns away to finish outside off. Omarzai looked to pull but missed
he backs away, and is beaten! Kishore slows it down again, and tosses it up to bowl on a length just outside off. The ball turns away as Omarzai looks to loft, and misses
this is much fuller and slower, and also on the stumps. Tucked towards cover by Omarzai
starts with a quickish length ball around off, which Iyer pushes towards deep midwicket
short of a length, and just outside off. He looks to dab to deep third, but gets it off the bottom of the bat to Buttler's right

falls short of Rashid rushing and sliding forward from deep midwicket! Short in length from Krishna, who went pretty close to off this time. Iyer was deep in the crease, and pulled it off the higher side of the bat for two
on the bounce to deep third, as Omarzai half-upper-cuts this good-length ball in the channel
another short-of-a-length ball from Krishna, who bowls in the corridor outside off. Punched to deep third by Iyer, who leaps in the crease a little
beaten! Short in length from Krishna again, just that this one is wider still outside off and climbs up rather sharply. Iyer looked to have a big slash, but missed

slapped to deep-backward point first ball! On the shorter side of a length from Krishna, as he bowled it wide enough outside off for Iyer to ride the bounce and free his arms to beat point to his left
full and quicker, and just outside off. He looks to lean into the drive, but is beaten on the outside edge
six first ball! Rashid bowls full and around sixth stump, but Omarzai reached out and launched that back over the bowler's head

taken at short cover! A tame dismissal in the end for an innings that seemed to be motoring along rather hurriedly. Rashid bowled it on a length around middle and off, and the ball turned away sharply. But what it also did was keep low. Arya was deep in the crease, and looking to pull. But so considerable was the turn away from him that he ended up reaching out for the ball, which popped up high off the top edge
on the bounce to the man at deep midwicket! Short in length from Rashid, who bowled on middle and off, and got the ball to turn in very slightly, as Iyer pulled it away
on a fullish length on leg, and turning away. Nudged to long-on
four off the bottom edge! This ball is quite full, and just outside leg, as it dips on Arya, who sweeps it to beat short fine leg to his left

punched wide of short third! Iyer played that aerially, but well away from the fielder. Rabada bowled on the shorter side of a length around off, and Iyer looked to ride the bounce, of which there was plenty. He opened the face of the a bat a bit, and just used the pace of the ball to dispatch it
swiped wide of the man at short fine leg! On a length on middle from Rabada, and the ball finished on off, as Arya mistimed his attempted pull

drilled through extra cover! Rabada bowled a low full toss, as the ball angled across and arrived around middle and off. But Arya is deep in the crease, and beats the man inside the circle to his left
a bouncer pitching on leg, and climbing above the batter's right shoulder. He looked to hook but missed

Rabada appeals for lbw, but it's turned down, and he gets no support from Buttler either. Gill reviews, though. Iyer looked to flick this delivery which shaped back in after pitching, and was beaten on the inside edge. The first replay all but confirms that it would have gone down leg; Rabada even walks back to his mark. And indeed, the ball landed on a length on off, and came back in sharply. Replays confirm it would have missed leg. So GT lose a review early. The batters got a leg bye in the meantime, as the ball dribbled away to the off side

beaten! A lovely, Test-match like line and length. Rabada angled it in, and bowled it on a short of a length on off. The ball barely shaped away after pitching, as Iyer looked to jab at it with an open face of the bat, but missed
too much width and he's slapped that through point, excellent work from Sai Sudharsan running round from square third to cut that off. Big, big over. 21 off it.
gorgeous! The best shot of the lot, one that he'll replay a million times in the years to come. Overpitched and he shows the full face of the bat to hit this dead straight back past the bowler.
square driven and this has carried all the way me thinks. Yes, it has. Just over the ropes. Reached out to play and opened the bat face late to pick his spot.
that's incredible! Driven on the up and has bisected cover point and extra cover to perfection . Stand and deliver stuff
appeal for lbw as this angles back in to hit the pad as Arya misses the flick. Stifled appeal but Buttler signals to Arshad it was going down leg.
off the edge, four! Arya living a charmed life. Shapes away from outside off, Arya throws his hands at that and gets a thick edge. A slip would've had a chance to take that
full and swinging away but from way outside off, wide called as Priyanshu swings and misses
worked into the gap at midwicket, came off a thickish inside edge. Looked to hit it towards mid-on.
flicked wayyyyyy back into the stands at deep square! Rabada strays onto the pads, Iyer needs no second invitation. Strong wrists to the fore as he picks it up and over
hits hard length and cramps Iyer for room, defended
sliced away over point, was looking to flick it over midwicket but the ball tailed late. Square third comes around to cut that
lofted down the ground! Timing pristine as he clears mid-on. On-drive on the up, what a way to start

slashed straight to third man this time! Prabhsimran had premeditated that, decided to throw his bat at that even though he was cramped for room and ended up slicing it to  Arshad who redeems himself.
more runs, they're beginning to have fun! It's a good old slash outside off, Arya gets a thick edge that flies away to the third man boundary. One bounce into the ropes

clobbered over deep square! Wow, that's Jayasuriya like. Siraj is probably tearing his hair out wondering what wrong he did! Touch fuller and shaping back into middle and leg, and Arya whips him over deep square. Wow, simply wow
looks to give him he charge and wallop him over midwicket but the ball cuts back in to hit him on the body
beaten again, this time Siraj shortens his length and gets this to zip away off the pitch from outside off
beaten by late movement as he tries to steer this to square third
late swing back in to strike the pad as Arya looks to flick, but the ball would've missed leg. They scamper a leg bye. Also pitched outside leg, so wouldn't have been an lbw anyway

a misfield from Arshad again, that's gonna have Rabada fuming! Prabhsimran didn't time this low full toss down the ground and Arshad ended up diving over the ball at mid-on. Tough, tough start to the season for him.
steps out to swing this length ball over mid-on but misses

mid-off, mid-on converge as Arya hits it high into the night sky, Arshad from mid-off finally goes for it but he had Rashid at the corner of his eye, and in the end the ball swirls away from him and goes straight through his hands. Big miss.
lofted over cover, got more elevation than distance. Also ended up slicing it a touch. Spongy bounce perhaps?
worked to long leg as they jog the single, Prabhsimran off the mark
Bunted to the off side
heaves across the line, gets a thickish inside edge that rolls to short fine.
has a big swing at that but is beaten by the angle across
solidly defends back as he stands tall
off the pads, races away to the fine leg boundary. Poor line from Siraj. Doesn't matter how the runs come for Kings
pick-up shot for four! Siraj bowls full on the pads and Arya displays strong wrists and a great hand-eye coordination. One bounce to the midwicket boundary
short of a length and shaping back into middle, Arya rises with the bounce and defends back

bashed over deep extra cover! But all it can do is reduce the margin of defeat for GT. Arshdeep angled it across from over the wicket, and went fullish and wide of off. Shahrukh reached out and sent the ball flying off the bat. PBKS win by 11 runs, and start the season with a win
another yorker, and this is just outside off. Arshad looks to jam it down, but gets an inside edge to the keeper's right

chopped on! Arshdeep strikes again, and Rutherford departs after losing steam in the second half of his innings. The ball was outswinger again, and pretty full and wide of off. Rutherford looked to drive at it away from his body, but only got an inside edge on to off stump. PBKS all but there now
a near yorker just outside off, and Rutherford can only bunt it towards long-off for two
a bottom-handed six over wide long-off! On a length from Arshdeep, who went wide of off, but Rutherford stood still in the crease, and crashed the ball for six

Tewatia is run-out! He was backing out way too far at the non-striker's end, and the stumps were broken after the ball tickled Arshdeep's left hand. Arshdeep had bowled an away-swinging low full toss a little wide of off, which Rutherford could only push back. Arshdeep threw his hand out, and PBKS were lucky enough to get a wicket
swiped over fine leg! Tewatia, in his typical style, gets across the stumps early, and dispatches this full toss dipping and arriving wide of off

another high-ish full toss around seventh stump, and it's Vyshak's day indeed. Tewatia went swiping but missed. But Tewatia reviews for a potential waist-high no-ball. Replays show that the ball seemed to be dipping as it angled across, and indeed, it is passing just below the waist
Rutherford gets across the stumps early, and Vyshak goes full and wide of off. The batter has a heave, but gets it off the inside half of the bat towards square leg
bam! Thumped to deep third! There was a fielder there, but he could hardly even spot the ball. Yet another (indeed!) full toss outside off from Vyshak, as Rutherford swung through the line
this is a dipping full toss arriving around seventh stump, as he goes low to push it towards deep extra cover
flayed wide of short third! He got across the stumps a bit, and as he got another full toss from Vyshak outside off, he opened the face of the bat late to beat the fielder
Vyshak keeps bowling wides outside off! Rutherford goes flashing at this high-ish full toss, and misses

bowled him! Buttler gets an inside edge, and that will be it, you'd think. Jansen bowled it on a length around sixth stump, as he angled it across. The ball seemed to shape away further after pitching, and Buttler, who was looking to hoick across the line, ended up getting an inside edge on to the leg stump
fullish again, and a slower ball around sixth stump. Heaved to deep square leg

falls just short of Shedge sliding to his left from deep third, and goes to the boundary after hitting his hands! Another full toss, as Jansen angled it across, and the ball arrived wide of off. That's Buttler's fifty too
a dipping and very full ball, as it hits Rutherford on his front pad. It looked like sliding down, even as Jansen appealed for lbw. The ball rolled off his pad to the off side
sliced to deep third! Rutherford finally gets it away, as he opens the face of the bat at this yorker-length ball wide of off, and sends it flying off his bat to beat deep third to his right
goes full and wide of off, as he angles it across. Buttler gets across, and mistimes a loft towards long-on
very full, and wide of off. Buttler slashes to deep cover for just a single, as GT seem to lose their way
another full toss, and angling across to arrive outside off. Rutherford swings and gets it off the outside half of the bat to deep third
lovely ball, at last! Rutherford gets across early, and Vyshak fires a yorker a bit wide of off. Rutherford looks to jam his bat down, but is beaten

a high full toss this time... as it comes on around seventh stump, and Rutherford has a heave but misses. Wide or no-ball for height not given, but Rutherford reviews! Replays, though, show the ball is dipping and finishing below his waist. But just below, though
on the bounce to the keeper! It is a full toss arriving around seventh stump, as Rutherford looks to drive but gets an outside edge
this is a wide, though! Three wides now! This is almost like a repeat of every previous delivery, as Vyshak looks to go full and wide of off while angling it across, and Rutherford leaves it alone

three wides in a row! Another one which angles away to pitch full and wide of off, as he looks to jam at it but misses. PBKS review, though. This seems to be taking a long time... And the replay shows Rutherford standing just outside off, with the ball passing the revised wide line. So the decision is overturned

another wide? Nope, not given. But the umpire reviews to confirm if it's a no-ball or a wide. Vyshak angled this across, and bowled full and wide of off. Rutherford left that alone, perhaps assuming that it would be a wide. It is given wide indeed
starts with a wide! He angles this across, and it flies off his hand to pitch well wide of off. Rutherford, though, still chases it and misses
pulled to deep square leg off the top half of the bat, as he reaches out for this short ball arriving wide of off. Extra bounce for Jansen there, and Buttler can only mistime that pull
full ball, and again wide-ish of off. Whipped to deep midwicket by playing away from his body
oohh, nicely bowled! Buttler was deep in the crease, and across the stumps, and Jansen fires a yorker bang on the stumps. Buttler eventually clips to deep midwicket
superb bowling! Jansen bowls a wide yorker outside off, and Rutherford can only squeeze it towards point
Jansen angles this across, and pitches around sixth stump. Drilled to deep cover
good work by Maxwell, who, from long-on, runs and dives to his left to save two! Buttler just got across, and lofted this low full toss back over the umpire's ehad
bowls a wide yorker that has Buttler reaching out to squeeze that to deep cover. Top, top over.
reaches out to bunt this full toss to cover. Came off the toe end.
excellent from Vyshak this time. Yorker-length and angling away, Rutherford looks to open the bat face to scythe it behind point, misses.
high full toss, in his hitting arc but Rutherford misses. Just some bat on it would've been enough for it to race away behind square on the off side.
goes for a wide yorker, Rutherford squeezes it back to the bowler. Was looking to reach out and drive
slices this hit to short third, good stop by Chahal on the bounce. Vyshak lucky to get away with that juicy full toss again
starts with a full toss, Rutherford reaches out to steer this to deep point. Would've been wide had he left it
full toss on the pads, flicked to deep square
another slower bouncer, looks to help it over point but misses
gets a top-edge and this flies over fine leg. Not where he intended but Rutherford's intent was very clear. He was looking to take on the short ball and went all in.
looks to stay leg side of the ball and upper cut this, but misses
holds his shape and waits for the cutter to arrive before slapping it between point and short third. Showing terrific cricket smarts. The chase is on, folks!

he has muscled that short ball over deep backward square! That would've been six even if the boundary was 20 yards bigger. Stoinis went for a short ball and it was as if Rutherford was waiting for it.
drilled to deep cover, Jansen cuts that off
scythed over cover! Took a step across to get close to the pitch and carved it over the infield. The timing was pristine
pushed to deep point to get off the mark

picks out Shashank at deep backward square leg! Arshdeep is lucky to get away with that. It was a length ball angling down, Sai Sudharsan timed this superbly and it was as if he momentarily forgot there was a man in the deep. Started slowly but made up for it as the innings progressed. GT are still very much in it.
hammered to long-off

teeing off like a golfer! Buttler hits that like he's on a driving range. Clean swing, long-handle, what a hit. Wayyyyyyyyyy over long-on. Arshdeep went for an off-cutter and this sat up for Buttler to give it a proper whack. Incredible hit
cut away to point, can't pick the gap that time
flat hit for four! Not far off from the umpire who quickly moved to his left to avoid that bullet hit. Sudharsan stepped out to take this on the full
the sound off the bat was beautiful! Too much flight on middle stump, Sudharsan is down on one knee as he slog-sweeps this to perfection. Right out of the screws
drilled to long-on
steps out and bludgeons the full toss to long-off
slider across the left-hander, lets it go and it's called wide
swept past short fine for four! Too full and down leg, easy pickings.
lofted cleanly, lofted superbly and he clears long-off comfortably. It started as a decent over, ends as an expensive one. Titans on the move.

Shreyas puts down a tough chance at cover!  Sudharsan was looking to go inside-out over cover, it looks like Shreyas was a split-second late in jumping to catch that. He seems to suggest he lost it in the ring of fire.
rocks back and pulls this over deep midwicket! Sudharsan moved leg side, Maxwell followed him to try and cramp him up but he managed to still generate enough power to clear the ropes
hacked away to deep midwicket
sliced over cover, Jansen running back didn't look like catching it. Buttler swung at a length ball but didn't get any power behind it
pulled to deep midwicket
another low full toss, although this is on his pads. Whipped to deep midwicket
ahh, he spots Buttler skip down, and floats it full and wide of off. Buttler reaches out and pushes to extra cover
low full toss on off, and belted hard towards long-on. That's also Sudharsan's fifty
this drifts in and arrives as a yorker outside leg. He looks to clip but the ball dribbles off the pad to the off side
on the bounce to deep midwicket, as he slog sweeps this full and straighter ball, which is also quicker
six over long-off! He hinted to skip down the track, before lofting this length ball angling across to arrive just outside off. Six over the shorter boundary
on the shorter side of a length on the stumps, and clipped to deep-backward square leg
wide outside leg! He angles this in, and bowls full and outside leg, even as Sudharsan shapes to make room, and looks to whip but misses
pulled to deep-backward square leg! Another forceful shot, as the ball is short and around middle and off
looks to scoop, but is beaten! Jansen bowls short and just outside off, and again the ball shapes back in to finish on top of middle and leg or thereabouts, as this time Buttler got across to play
a short ball angling in, as it pitches on the stumps and finishes outside leg. Buttler makes room and punches it back towards Jansen
thrashed to deep-backward square leg! Short in length, and just outside leg, as Buttler stands outside leg too, and absolutely clubs the ball for four
launched wide of long-on! On a length on the stumps, but Buttler has backed away early, and uses his bottom hand to whip it aerially for four
on a length on the stumps, and quicker too. Swatted towards long-off after going deep in the crease
looks to reverse sweep, but is beaten! A full and quick ball just outside off, and this one doesn't turn. Buttler shapes early to play the shot, and misses
this is slower, and fuller on middle. It is pushed towards deep midwicket
oohh, the wrong one! On a fullish length on leg, and turning away to finish on off, as he dabs it down close to the stumps

pulled wide of long-on! The man at deep midwicket runs and dives to his right, but is beaten! Short in length from Chahal, who bowled it on the stumps, before Sudharsan went back to pull hard and flat
fullish and straight, with a hint of turn away. Pushed down to long-off

dropped by Omarzai! He pops it over for six at deep third, as Sudharsan went slashing hard at this short-of-a-length ball finishing around sixth stump after shaping away. Omarzai, moving to his left, seemed to have overrun, and even as he leapt, the ball went over the rope off his hands
change of pace again, and on a hard length just outside off. Buttler nudges it towards midwicket by half-closing the face of the bat for a quick single

wow, there seemed to be a noise as the ball passed the bat... but there's no appeal whatsoever! It was a slower ball from Stoinis, who bowled on a good length around seventh stump. Buttler went pushing, but was beaten
on a length, and just outside off. Whipped to deep midwicket to get off the mark
on the shorter side of a length on middle and leg, and pulled to deep square leg

outside edge, and wide of the keeper! There's no slip at this stage o the game, and Sudharsan has some luck going his way. He goes driving away from his body at this full ball wide-ish of off, and gets four
on a length, and around sixth stump. Punched hard towards cover point

taken at cover point! The leading edge ballooned the ball up, and Arya kept his eyes on the ball to take it despite a stumble. Gill came down the pitch to try and whip this full ball angling in quickly towards leg, but seemed to have closed the face of the bat a bit too early. Simple catch for Arya in the end to break a quick stand
goes to deep square leg after he mistimes an attempted slog sweep! Again he went down to have a free swing at this full delivery around middle and off, but got it off the higher side of the bat
swung away behind square! Full and dipping on off, and Gill gets his front leg out on middle to slog sweep it for four
he looks to swipe at this fullish and quick ball on middle and leg, but the ball popped up off his pads to go towards short third
wide ball! Full and outside leg, and he missed as he looked to sweep
good stop by Shedge, who runs and tumbles to his left from deep square leg to keep this to two. Full and flat, and on the stumps, as Sudharsan swept at it
swatted over long-on! Length ball asking to be hit, Gill cleared his front leg and gave it a proper whack. Held his pose for the cameras briefly.
looks to whip it over square leg but is cramped for room, lobs back towards the bowler off the pad
misses the flick, the ball rolls off the pad to square leg
plays the signature Sai Sudharsan ramp! Gets inside the line, stays low and scoops it over fine leg
slower ball on middle, Gill nudges this into the leg side and gets across for a quick single. This got stuck into the pitch and bounced extra as Gill checked his shot
nips back in to hit the pad and deflect to the off side. Sudharsan was looking to work it with the angle and they steal a leg bye
sashays down the pitch and drills this over extra cover! Gill converted this into the slotball thanks to his footwork
slower and fuller on middle, drilled straight to mid-on
helped along to clear fine leg! Poor ball from Azmat. Short and angling down, easy pickings. It sat up nicely to be helped along
plays the short-arm jab to deep midwicket
the whiplash of Gill! A combination of bottom-handed power and wrist work as he picks this length ball up and over the midwicket fence.
angles one back into middle and leg from around the stumps, worked to deep midwicket
cramped for room as this length ball nips back in, bunted to the off side as they scamper a single. Shedge has a shy at the stumps at the bowler's end from cover, would've been close.
punched straight to cover point, frustration building.
dug in short and angling down leg, Sudharsan is looking to pull but bails out in the end in anticipation of a wide, not called.
looks to arch back and ramp this over the slips, but misses.
stands tall and punches this length delivery straight to cover point
pushed to mid-off for a quick single
stunning stroke to get going! That's full and angling into the pads and Sudharsan picks this slower ball quickly and deposits it over long-n.
pulled into the gap at deep midwicket. No more than a short-arm jab again from Sai Sudharsan
pushed into the covers as they scamper a quick single. A direct hit at the bowler's end from cover would've made it interesting.  Priyansh Arya was the fielder, Gill was miles short
mistimes a dive to mid-off. The bat face turned in his hand
flicked uppishly to deep midwicket where Shashank is patrolling the boundary
nips back in off a length from around the stumps to strike Sudharsan high on the thigh pad as he tries to tuck it square
punched straight to deep point
struck on the box as he tries to pull, was cramped for room. Sai Sudharsan was also overbalanced.
beaten as he slashes at an away-going delivery, no feet and it was a lot fuller than he expected
full and shaping away from off-stump, firmly defended towards point
dabs this to short third. Hint of seam movement away that time
strays down leg and Sai Suds gets this off the thigh pad as the ball races to the fine leg boundary
